notes: TAS playback stays in sync on laggy games. The MC-NES core gained a poll-indexed replay mode: it advances the movie only on frames the game reads the controller, so a frame where the core lags differently from the emulator no longer shifts every later input. Lag data for 322 published NES runs ships with the app and downloads with the run, so nothing else is needed. Super Mario Bros. 3 warps now plays to the ending. Needs MC-NES build 20260904 from Settings > Install.
